verdict.rationale: First-party docs state developers can select from 5k+ voices across 31 languages with customization options. The docs also cover switching between multiple voices in one conversation and tuning pronunciation and speaking speed (0.7x–1.2x). Because the story is phrased 'or', the broad voice library alone satisfies it. Missing for 10: any evidence of plugging in third-party TTS providers, independent or hands-on corroboration of the voice library's breadth and quality, and in-depth docs on how voices are selected or customized via the API.
